paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: The pie chart shows the distribution of data sources in the AttrEval-Simulation. There are six slices in total, representing different data sources. The slices are labeled as follows: ENTITYQUEST, colored blue, making up approximately 26.0% of the chart; HOTPOTQA, colored red, accounting for around 24.2%; TRIVIAQA, colored orange, comprising about 22.7%; POPQA, colored yellow, making up around 21.6%; WEBQUESTIO, colored teal, representing about 3.6%; and TREC, colored green, accounting for approximately 1.9%. The chart includes percentage labels inside or next to each slice and does not have a legend; the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size.
